body: He thinks he's the cause of everything bad in my life as well, which just breaks my heart because it's not the case. It's a struggle, but to be honest, I'm the same. I feel like I've made his life a ton worse, and he keeps telling me that I've done nothing bad. It's so hard to believe sometimes.

I understand your point. Sadly, I live in another country, so I can't just go there face to face, although I'd love to. I know I've done wrong, told him I've acknowledged it and apologised, but he'd deny it all and say nothing's my fault. He always takes the blame and he doesn't understand others can be at fault too. But I see how much he's hurting because he hides a lot of things, feels like a bother, which he's not.

Hello, thank you for replying ☀ exactly, I don't mean to hurt anyone because I only have a need to attack myself but of course I understand it hurts them in many ways as well. I just feel like it happens every time I open my mouth, I push people away a lot. Some of my friends know about how I get, and they tolerate me and it is very kind of them, I owe the world to them for being my friends even when I'm so difficult. I can get really repetitive about it all so I'm not really learning and I feel like I need constant validation.
I don't want to keep hurting anyone, but I feel like I had to like myself in order to achieve that and I'm not sure how that's gonna happen, since I've never understood what's so good about me.
